name: write-with-purpose
description: Draft from notes, develop an idea, or revise existing prose for a specific reader. Check the finished writing against the author's intent, evidence, and constraints.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and revise prose for its intended reader.
interface.longDescription: Develop a draft from the author's ideas or improve an existing draft, from a targeted correction to a stronger argument. Preserve the author's voice and the scope of the evidence. Check the delivered text against the brief.
